title: crataegus oxyacantha f. alboplena
intro: Crataegus oxyacantha f. alboplena, commonly known as White Hawthorn, is a specific cultivar of the Crataegus oxyacantha species, a flowering plant in the rose family. White Hawthorn has been traditionally used for its various health benefits, which include reducing blood pressure, improving cardiovascular health, and acting as an antioxidant. Its therapeutic actions include vasodilation, anti-inflammatory effects, and a potential role in improving lipid profiles. The bioactive constituents of White Hawthorn include flavonoids, oligomeric proanthocyanidins (OPCs), and other phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
